meaning: There is a universal-accessibility modal interpretation with an actual contingent individual and a distinct existing cause of every contingent individual at every world, but no necessary being at the actual world. An analyst’s model/consequence test; no result proves Kantian idealism, real possibility, premise truth or a refutation of God. See docs/kant-cosmological-inference.md.
